title: WTM Maces No Recipe
description: A Simple datapack to disable WTM Maces's Recipes!
body:
# Description
Do you hate that in [Way too many Maces](https://modrinth.com/datapack/silvers_way-too-many-maces) you are able to craft these maces, but what if you dont want that?

Well, with this datapack all of the Recipes from that datapack is disabled!

## Notes:
To allow these mace recipes to be crafted just do this command:
```
/datapack disable "file/No WTM Maces's Recipe.zip"
```
and to enable it just do:
```
/datapack Enable "file/No WTM Maces's Recipe.zip"
```


### Comments:
Well? Did you like it?, Consider checking my other Projects!
